The upper half of the circle forms a straight angle of \(180^\circ\). Along it, the angles sum to

\[
40^\circ + \text{shaded angle} + 50^\circ + 30^\circ = 180^\circ.
\]

So the central angle of the shaded sector is

\[
180^\circ-(40^\circ+50^\circ+30^\circ)=60^\circ.
\]

Since the point is chosen uniformly from the whole disk, the probability is the ratio of the sector’s angle to \(360^\circ\):

\[
\frac{60}{360}=\frac16.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{1}{6}}
\]
